_comment: UX-07 (R32): one single-edit mutant per decision the UXU cases claim; node tests/ux/usage/run-mutants.mjs applies each to a copy and requires a DECLARED case to fail on an assertion.

mutants.what: the readable result's note claims its content is removed at expiry (WR-UXF-4)
mutants.find: After that the result is no longer available;
mutants.replace: After that the content is removed;
cases: UXU-01 result notes say when the result stops being readable, never that content is removed or deleted

mutants.what: the expired result's note claims its content was removed (WR-UXF-4)
mutants.find: return `The result stopped being available at ${at}. Request status and usage remain available.`;
mutants.replace: return `The result expired at ${at} and its content was removed.`;
cases: UXU-01 result notes say when the result stops being readable, never that content is removed or deleted

mutants.what: Settings promises deletion after the retention periods (WR-UXF-5)
mutants.find: for limited periods, after which it can no longer be read.
mutants.replace: for limited periods, then delete it.
cases: UXU-02 Settings' serving retention says stored content stops being readable, with no deletion promise
